title: 高盛AI让分析师：从做图表转向想点子，客户价值能提升多少？
speaker: Kevin Sneader

segments.en: you know when this whole AI story began like my my immediate thought was how does this change the day-to-day of an analyst in the nitty-gritty work what have you learned about that just quickly just quickly on well it does I mean
segments.zh: 当人工智能故事开始时，我立刻想到，这会如何改变分析师的日常工作？关于这点，你学到了什么？

segments.en: I'd go back to when I was an analyst and you're sitting putting together data and you have this you're recombinant you were there too you have the you're recombinant my goodness I figured out the market share there's no you're recombinant now anymore it's impressive on this a little bit
segments.zh: 回想我当分析师时，要整理数据，做各种重组分析。现在这些都不需要手动做了，令人印象深刻。

segments.en: of an anti-climax we have absolutely learned that you can indeed do a lot more than just automate you can improve the quality of the output and you don't need your analyst to be sweating the chart instead
segments.zh: 我们确实学到，人工智能不仅能自动化，还能提高输出质量。分析师不必再为图表费心。

segments.en: what they can sweat is the idea what is it we should engage our client on how do we bring to them something that will really make a difference to their performance their value and that is what
segments.zh: 他们可以专注于想法：我们应该与客户探讨什么？如何带来真正影响其表现和价值的东西？

segments.en: across Goldman Sachs we're actually very focused on is giving our colleagues this extra boost so they can do more and better with our clients and I think we've learned that that's actually where the big opportunity stands
segments.zh: 在高盛，我们非常专注于给同事额外的助力，让他们能为客户做得更多更好。我们认为这就是巨大的机会所在。

segments.en: better client experience better production from our site makes a better outcome for everyone that's a big focus
segments.zh: 更好的客户体验、更高的产出，为所有人带来更好的结果，这是我们的重点。
